business_problem: With fundamental shifts — from the ubiquity of mobile fintech to the advent of open finance across institutions — the finance industry is in exciting flux. Banco Bradesco understood that meeting evolving customer expectations with better financial solutions was a key priority.
solution_summary: Banco Bradesco built its Databricks implementation around Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, Databricks Data + AI Platform, Lakeflow Jobs. With fundamental shifts — from the ubiquity of mobile fintech to the advent of open finance across institutions — the finance industry is in exciting flux. Banco Bradesco understood that meeting evolving customer expectations with better financial solutions was a key priority. Databricks SQL serves governed analytics, dashboards, and ad hoc queries for business users and operational teams. Unity Catalog applies centralized governance, lineage, auditing, and access control across shared data assets. Databricks Data + AI Platform provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workflows in this deployment. Lakeflow Jobs schedules and orchestrates recurring data pipelines and transformations.
